dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: ...And in the end, we managed to settle things peacefully.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And there I was, wondering how I'd report a full-on conflict with the Fatui to the old man...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: This area is under our jurisdiction by right, so we can do as we please. As to whether our actions might stir up unnecessary trouble... Well, that's a different story.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Oh, wait... You're not from Nod-Krai. There wouldn't have been any problems if you'd have taught them a lesson on our behalf.

choices.text: Why, you should've said so earlier.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Hahaha. I'll remember that the next time this happens.

choices.text: Would've been glad to be of service.
